audit_timing: recorded after recovery launch and before any recovered component scientific result

G1.label: thermodynamics / perturbation-source evolution
exact_source_role: The perturbation module integrates perturbation equations and constructs/interpolates source functions S^X(k,tau).
start_sources_at_tau_c_over_tau_h is used in perturbations.c to locate the initial source-computation time by bisection in the thermo-to-Hubble timescale ratio.
The tight-coupling, hierarchy and perturbation integration/sampling controls in G1 therefore act before transfer projection, at the source-generation/evolution layer.
G1.interpretation_if_sufficient: Localizes the precision sensitivity to the thermodynamics/perturbation/source-generation layer as a group. It does not identify a unique scalar parameter or a unique code defect.

G2.label: k/l/hyperspherical/q sampling and projection grid
exact_source_role: k_step_sub and k_step_super enter construction of the perturbation-module k sampling grid around the recombination scale.
transfer.c constructs the transfer-function q grid using q_linstep, q_logstep_spline/q_logstep_trapzd and q_numstep_transition.
transfer_init passes hyper_sampling_flat and related hyperspherical precision parameters into the spherical/hyperspherical interpolation structure used for transfer projection.
G2.interpretation_if_sufficient: Localizes the sensitivity to the sampling/projection-grid layer spanning perturbation k sampling and transfer q/hyperspherical sampling. It does not by itself distinguish k-grid from q-grid from hyperspherical interpolation.

G3.label: scalar CMB transfer-support truncation
exact_source_role: The transfer module computes Delta_l^X(q) from perturbation source functions.

For scalar temperature source types, transfer.c directly compares l against (k - transfer_neglect_delta_k_S_t*) times the recombination angular-distance factor and marks transfer contributions for neglect when the threshold condition is met.
neglect_CMB_sources_below_visibility and transfer_neglect_late_source are likewise transfer/source support truncation controls.
G3.interpretation_if_sufficient: Localizes the sensitivity to scalar CMB transfer/source-support truncation as a group. It does not prove that any one neglect threshold is defective.

scope: This map is outcome-independent and constrains interpretation only. It cannot change group membership, thresholds, classification rules or K1 status after component results are seen.
